eyebrow: Three pieces of a sharded cluster

steps.label: Shards
steps.sub: each a replica set of data

code:
LOW CARDINALITY
  e.g. shard key = status (3 values)
  -> can only ever split into a few chunks

MONOTONICALLY INCREASING
  e.g. shard key = auto-incrementing _id
  -> all new writes hit the same shard

Fix: high-cardinality, often hashed, key
caption: Same failure mode as a bad relational partition key.
